v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: The list should only contain strings
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Each time is represented as hour:minute

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: The user shall be able to enter their desired meeting duration
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: The user shall be able to enter their event calendar
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: The system shall calculate all the available times a meeting can be held
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: The system shall not include any meeting times 15:00 and beyond on Fridays
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: The system shall return a list that contain times in a string type
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_6: The system shall return an empty list if no valid meeting time is available

v2_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is that the user enters their existing event calender and their desired meeting duration, the system will return a list of all the meeting start times that will fit their schedule
v2_human_g3_input: Existing event calendar which is a list, each time is in string format, valid times are 0-24 desired meeting duration - integer - formatted in hours

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: A list that contains a time outside working hours
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: A time from 15:00 to 17:00 is included in resulting list

v2_human_g3_output: The function should return a list of all the valid starting times during work hours for a meeting except Fridays v2_human 15:00
v2_human_g3_tb: If there are multiple times available, the system shall choose the earliest time

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: No 2 events can be held at the same time
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: No times from 15:00 to 17:00 should be included in return list
